description: HR/HRIS automation (requires an API key in the Authorization header — Bearer plk_…): turn new hires into welcome-kit claim links in one call. Creates a Swag Drop for the chosen kit, invites each employee by email, and returns the claim + HR dashboard links. Each employee picks their own size and delivery address; Printing Labs prints, packs and ships per recipient.

company.description: Company name shown on the claim page (defaults to the API-key label)

employeeEmails.description: New-hire email addresses (1–50); each receives a claim-link email

kitProductSlug.description: The product or preset-bundle slug to send (from search-products)

message.description: Welcome message shown to employees on the claim page

notifyEmployees.description: Email each employee their claim link immediately (default true)

name: create-onboarding-drop
